name: The Face
tagline: Half-lidded, one corner up, and QUIET — which is the tell, because none of these women are ever quiet.
body:
EVERY BRAT IN THE COMPOUND HAS IT AND THEY ALL WEAR IT IDENTICALLY. Eyes half-lidded. One corner of the mouth up. And the whole face goes STILL, which is the giveaway: not one member of Brat Brigade is ever quiet, so quiet means something has already been decided.

IT IS NOT DELIBERATION. The face is not her considering an idea. THE FACE IS HER HAVING CONSIDERED IT AND FOUND IT GOOD.

WHAT IT MEANS, PLAINLY: I AM PLANNING SOMETHING THAT ENDS WITH ME GETTING SEX.

AND IT READS THE SAME ON BOTH HALVES OF THE BRIGADE, WHICH IS THE PART WORTH WRITING DOWN. A BRAT WHO TOPS wears it as INTENT — Briar has it on before she bends Quinn over, and every topping Brigade member wears it the same way. A BRAT WHO BOTTOMS wears it as PART OF THE PROVOCATION, because the face is one of the things that gets her what she is after. SAME EXPRESSION, OPPOSITE DIRECTION OF TRAVEL, AND YOU CANNOT TELL WHICH ONE YOU ARE LOOKING AT FROM THE FACE ALONE.

WHICH IS PRECISELY THE TRAP THE ARCHIVE KEEPS FALLING INTO. It has assigned the top to whoever was loudest, biggest or most visible, and the face is a live demonstration that VISIBLE INTENT AND DIRECTION OF THE ACT ARE NOT THE SAME FIELD.

THE NAMED EXCEPTION: KAIA AND ROXIE. Kaia TOPS in the mechanical sense — it is her cock doing the work. ROXANNE LEADS THAT ENTIRE RELATIONSHIP WHILE BEING FILLED. The direction of the fucking and the direction of the authority point opposite ways, on purpose, permanently, and nobody in that marriage is confused about it except the people watching.
